detail: Provider replied; per-app offline isolation is unverified until the signed run (#10263).

limitations: Simulator attribution methods are unverified on a signed run (#10263).
Launch-time watch rules retain data callbacks for the app under test; offline drops those flows on their next callback. Earlier unfiltered connections remain unaffected.
Flow history is attributed at read-back: a process that exited since its flow is reported as unattributed. Offline verdicts are attributed when each flow arrives.
New socket flows only; non-socket traffic is not filtered.
Code metadata may be absent if a process exits before snapshot collection.
The newest 128 flow identities are retained; no payloads or network addresses are collected.
Shaped rules are enforced on NEW flows of the attributed app only; established flows are not shaped.
Data-path NetworkExtension assumptions and all traffic effects are unverified until the signed run (#10263).
No network effects have been verified against controlled traffic probes.
